summary: Rollout canary provisioning blocked by GPU quota (INC-2025-0217)
related_confluence_pages: Incident Review Summary (H1 2025): Capacity & quota exhaustion incidents  paging and ownership gaps
description:
Issue summary:
Console/Rollouts canary step attempted to add 2 GPUs to canary pool in us-east. Provisioning failed with quota exceeded. Rollout paused; fallback remained pinned longer than expected, causing increased latency for a subset of traffic.

Impact:
Degraded performance for a subset of Hosted API traffic due to prolonged fallback pin.

Mitigation:
- Switched canary to us-west temporarily
- Reduced canary size
- Added a preflight check proposal: block canary if quota headroom < 10%

Owner team:
Eng Platform (Console/Rollouts)
comments: Avery Johnson: Confirmed quota exceeded on A100 us-east for canary pool. Changing region is the fastest unblock.
Grace OConnor: Please link Slack thread in #incidents for incident record.
Rohan Mehta: If we need to keep canary in us-east we should request quota headroom ahead of time.
Avery Johnson: Mitigation applied; rollout unblocked. Following up on preflight check change.
